submission.reasoning: An interactive cmd.exe session (proc-29da349e7e) run by WORKSTATION5\wardog at High integrity started bitsadmin.exe (proc-826bdb1e01) at 2020-10-23T06:36:43Z. bitsadmin created a foreground BITS /transfer job that downloaded content from raw.githubusercontent.com (the Atomic Red Team T1197 page) and saved it as a .ps1 script, C:\Users\wardog\AppData\Local\Temp\bitsadmin1_flag.ps1. Using BITS to pull a remote file and rename it as a PowerShell script in Temp matches T1197 (BITS Jobs) and ingress tool transfer. The Atomic Red Team source suggests an attack emulation or test, but the behavior itself is adversarial. No other admin or update tool started it. The graph has no file entity for the download, so I could not confirm the file was written. Response: isolate and triage the host, rotate the wardog account's credentials, delete or verify the dropped .ps1, and block the download URL.
